title: Shared-Memory Bank Conflict Detector
constraints: 4 lanes, each with an 8-bit word address: lane i uses `addr[8i+7 : 8i]`. Only lanes with `valid[i] = 1` access memory.
Memory has 4 banks; a word lives in bank `address[1:0]`.
Lanes that read the **same address** are served together (broadcast): no conflict.
`cycles` = the largest number of **distinct** addresses any single bank must serve (0 if no lane is valid). `conflict = (cycles > 1)`.
hints: With 4 lanes there are only 6 lane pairs. Compare banks and addresses pairwise.
For each bank, count the distinct addresses: a lane counts only if no *lower* valid lane in the same bank had the same address.
Then take the maximum over the 4 banks.
